text: An entity is itself blocked if one or more blocked persons own 50% or more in the AGGREGATE, directly or indirectly.
Indirect ownership multiplies down the chain (e.g., A owns 60% of X, X owns 60% of Y => A indirectly owns 36% of Y).
Being absent from the SDN list does NOT mean an entity is clear; apply the 50% aggregation.
Live SDN/Consolidated list ingested from OFAC; this seed states the deterministic aggregation rule.
